difficulty_reason: The proof passes from a middle-term decomposition to a decomposition of the full exact sequence through relative-projective U-resolutions, indecomposable U-cover matching and the source-local rigidity theorem. These are substantive structural steps beyond routine splitting of vector spaces; all author arguments and diagrams are retained.
